people.imagined: Dusk on the coal road with the baskets coming up; he counts one more basket on the cord at his wrist and looks at the sky, expecting rain.
people.subject: The moment: dusk on the coal road below the forge; he has just counted one more basket on the knotted cord at his wrist and glances at the sky, expecting rain, then turns grave eyes on the viewer. Face: a long, honest, sun-lined face of forty-six; grey-green eyes squinting up at weather; a stubborn square chin; thin lips pressed; a short brown beard flecked with grey; deep red pressure-marks visible at the open collar where the basket straps have bitten for thirty years. Hair: brown going grey, tied low at the neck with a strip of black cord. Body: tall, spare, shoulders bowed under a long habit of carrying. Clothing: a heavy dark grey-brown cloth tunic, clean and well fitted, sleeves short; over it a black felt apron; a basket-strap lying across both shoulders, and the groove it has worn in the cloth of each shoulder paler than the rest; leather leggings tied at the shin; heavy boots grey with coal dust. Hands and objects: a cord thick with small knots is wound round the left wrist and held up in the foreground; the right hand holds a notched tally stick; a pair of empty baskets rest at his feet. Background: a stony mountain slope, a line of tiny carriers with baskets climbing a switchback track, heavy dark clouds massing. Light: low grey light from the upper left, a thin red glow of the forge far above. Expression: cautious, honest and stubborn; a man who has twice been told to dig faster.

people.imagined: The anvil hall at the end of a heat; he tilts his good right ear toward the viewer because the left has been deaf for forty years.
people.subject: The moment: the anvil hall at the end of a heat; he leans on a hammer shaft and turns his good right ear toward the viewer with a scowl, as if he did not hear, because the left ear has been deaf for forty years. Face: a heavy, flat face of fifty-five; a beard singed to a straight flat line along the jaw, as though cut with a rule, big and plain; a short broad nose with open pores full of soot; small hard black eyes; thick grey brows; a cruel set mouth; skin red from fire; a scorched pale patch at the left temple. Hair: grey, cropped short, thin. Body: very thick, wide chest, thick neck, arms like logs, standing with the hammer-shoulder dropped lower. Clothing: a black felt apron scorched at the edges over a dark grey-brown heavy cloth tunic with short sleeves; an iron ring on the thumb; leather wrist-guards; heavy boots. Hands and objects: a heavy black hammer with its head resting on his shoulder; his thumb-ring of iron; blackened nails; his knuckles scarred and cracked. Background: a dim forge hall, a red glow from a furnace mouth, the curve of an anvil edge, a rack of tongs on the wall. Light: orange forge-glow from the lower left, cool light on the upper left. Expression: loyal, stubborn and cruel-eyed; a man who counts folds and waits for the one short of nine.

people.imagined: Bright morning in the yard with a letter to his father; he looks up from the page; his skin has no scars at all.
people.subject: The moment: a bright morning in the forge yard; he stands with a folded letter in his hand and looks up mildly from it at the viewer, as he does when his father writes about the halberd. Face: a smooth, scarless, mild young face of twenty, which is strange among smiths: pale clear skin without a single burn mark, big and plain; soft brown eyes; level brows; a small humble smile; a round chin; a faint ink smudge at the thumb. Hair: black, neatly combed and tied up with a plain cord. Body: slender and upright, modest in stance, narrow-chested beside the heavy men behind him. Clothing: a black felt apron, immaculate, over a dark grey-brown tunic with the sleeves rolled to show clean unmarked forearms; an iron thumb-ring; clean boots. Hands and objects: a letter folded in thirds in his left hand (no writing visible), a small hammer in his right, handle polished pale; a leather case of chisels at his belt. Background: a stone yard with a forge wall and a tall chimney, a coal heap, morning sky, two heavy smiths blurred in the doorway. Light: clear morning light from the upper left. Expression: patient, humble and reserved, the face of a boy who has been left behind and does not complain.

people.imagined: At the polishing wheel, her heel taps out of time on the treadle, and a smear of grey paste across her cheek like a seal.
people.subject: The moment: at the foot-treadle polishing wheel; her heel taps out of time on the treadle, and she turns her head with a quick bright grin at the viewer, a smear of paste across her cheek. Face: a quick, eager face of twenty-two; a broad stripe of grey-pink polishing paste smeared across one cheek and worn like a seal, big and plain; sharp bright brown eyes; a pointed chin; thin lively brows; a small gap in the front teeth. Hair: black, in two buns, a tiny speck of paste in them. Body: small and bouncy, one foot on the treadle. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic with short sleeves, a black felt apron stained pale pink at the front; a cloth tied over the lower face and pulled down to her neck; boots. Hands and objects: a half-polished sword blade held flat in both hands against a wheel, its half bright as a mirror and half dull; a tin of pumice paste beside her. Background: a polishing shed with a wheel, hanging blades on a rack, a sack of pumice. Light: bright light from the upper left, a gleam from the blade. Expression: ambitious, impatient and cheerful; mouthing a verse under her breath.

people.imagined: Standing in the coal yard, hands spread to show black creases like inked lines, asking again for the tongs.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight in the coal yard, both palms turned up toward the viewer, she asks, as she does every week, whether a daughter may carry the tongs. Face: a stubborn little face of sixteen with a firm jaw; wide honest dark eyes; soot on the nose; her chin lifted; chapped lips; a smudge of black on one eyebrow; her palms are held steady though the arms tremble from the effort of asking. Hair: a short black braid with ash in it, a scrap of red thread. Body: small, wiry and braced like a mule. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic with sleeves short, a small black felt apron, clean though darkened at the hem; a basket-strap wound round her shoulder; scuffed boots; a red scrap of cloth is tied to the pole's end, her brother's gift; her bare ankle above the boot shows a coal-bruise the size of a thumb. Hands and objects: both palms held out, coal ground so deep that every crease looks inked in black, large and plain; a carrying pole leaning on her shoulder with a basket of lumps hanging from it; the creases on each hand are black lines like drawn ink, and a pale pink blister is forming under the pole's grip. Background: a coal yard with stacked baskets, a mule, a black heap and a wisp of smoke; beside her a taller smith in a black apron walks past without looking. Light: hazy light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, brave and honest.

people.imagined: At the mine gate selling to a buyer, he flicks his cuff so the little bell rings.
people.subject: The moment: at the mine gate selling to a buyer; he shakes his sleeve so that a tiny brass bell at the cuff rings, and flashes a gap-toothed grin at the viewer, with a short rough bar of dark iron on his open palm. Face: a handsome, sly face of twenty-six; a wide gap-toothed grin, a visible gap between the front teeth; bright confident eyes; a neat thin moustache; a small dimple; the buyer's hand is just visible at the frame's edge, reaching for the bar. Hair: oiled black hair, a bright silk cord at the topknot. Body: slim, preening and leaning in toward the buyer; behind him on the cart sits a row of grey ingots tied with red cord, each stamped with a small star-shape mark (no writing). Clothing: a too-fine bright blue coat of silk-brocade-feeling cloth over the grey tunic, clean, with a small brass bell sewn at the right cuff; a black felt apron worn open as a token; polished boots; a pouch heavy with coppers swings at his belt, the gate tip he has kept; his boots are blue-black and shine; the little bell at his cuff has a tiny bright dent where he flicks it with his thumbnail. Hands and objects: a short rough bar of dark iron held out on the open left palm as if it sang; the right hand lifts the bell cuff. Background: a mine gate with a cart, ore baskets, a rough mountain. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: arrogant, deceitful and charming; a man who can tell how star iron sings without having heard it.

people.imagined: Swinging the third hammer left-handed at the anvil, red cloth round the right wrist, glaring at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: he swings a hammer left-handed over the anvil and glares at the viewer, jaw set, because he said the Rite would leave the mountain with the steppe boy and carried coal for a month for it. Face: a narrow, hard boy's face of eighteen; fierce dark brows; angry bright eyes; a bruise yellowing on one cheek; sweat; a faint down on the lip; the older smith with the singed beard is a blurred dark shape at the edge of the frame, watching the beat; sweat drops from his chin onto the anvil and hisses. Hair: black, cropped, a rag round the brow soaked dark. Body: wiry, broad-shouldered for his age, a bonded digger's boy. Clothing: a black felt apron over the grey-brown tunic, short sleeves; heavy boots; a thick leather wrist-guard on the left; the red cloth on his right wrist is knotted with a tail of thread that flutters in the heat. Hands and objects: the right wrist is wrapped in a strip of bright red cloth, big and clear; the left hand grips a hammer high above a glowing bar; beside the anvil a bucket of black water steams, and a basket of coal waits as his month's penance. Background: anvil, sparks, a red glow, a bigger smith's shadow behind; his left forearm is ridged with veins and a half-healed burn runs along the outer edge. Light: orange forge-glow from the lower right, white spark flecks. Expression: wrathful, loyal and brave.

people.imagined: He is listening to a blade before he looks at it, eyes closed, head tilted, a thumbnail flicked against the edge.
people.subject: The moment: in the forge hall he listens to a blade before looking at it; eyes closed, head tilted, he flicks the blade with a thumbnail beside his ear, then opens his eyes on the viewer. Face: a short, thick, strong face of fifty-five; a scorched, red-brown beard; face and forearms speckled white with old spark scars, plain and many; heavy brows singed pale; deep-set dark eyes; sun-red skin; on the anvil beside him lie two other blades, a grey-brown one and a dark one, laid by length; his forearm is mottled with a hundred tiny white scars from sparks, each the size of a grain of rice; his burnt beard is coarse and curls in rust-coloured wires; the iron rings on the felt robe click faintly as he breathes and each carries a dull orange reflection from the forge. Hair: iron-grey, short, a leather band round the brow. Body: short and very thick, a smith's chest and shoulders. Clothing: a robe of heavy felt sewn with small iron rings, black, clean, thick, hanging open over a grey-brown tunic, and a black apron edged in red-brown leather; iron thumb-ring; boots. Hands and objects: a plain bare sword blade, its steel with a faint blue-white shimmer, held up by the ear; a branding iron hangs at his belt, glowing faintly dull red. Background: a smoky forge hall in shadow, a distant red glow, an anvil, a rack of blades. Light: orange glow from the lower left, a thin cool light on the blade from the upper left. Expression: diligent, stubborn and calm, the face of a man listening.

people.imagined: Standing in his black apron at the doorway of the anvil hall, holding the coal ration slip; faintly proud.
people.subject: The moment: he stands in the doorway of the anvil hall with arms folded, looking down his nose at the viewer, a coal ration slip crumpled in one fist. Face: a strong, regular face of fifty like his father's but unscarred; smooth ruddy skin; cold, certain dark eyes; thin sharp brows; a short neat beard; a lifted chin; a thin white line of scar crosses his left thumb; the felt of the apron is so old that its black has gone to a dull brown at the edges and it carries a neat seam his father sewed. Hair: black with grey, combed back and bound with a black cord. Body: short, thick, powerful, standing square. Clothing: a black felt apron of iron-thread felt, soft with age and spotless, never taken off, over a dark tunic; sleeves short; polished boots; a cracked coal-scuttle stands empty by the door, and he has set a heavy key on a cord at his belt, the key to the coal store. Hands and objects: arms folded; blackened nails; an iron thumb-ring; the coal slip in the fist; a heavy hammer on a hook behind him; his stance is wide, thumbs hooked into the apron strings. Background: the dark doorway of a forge hall and an anvil, a rack of finished halberd blades; behind him in the hall two apprentices hammer a long bar in rhythm. Light: red forge-glow from behind, hard light from the upper left. Expression: arrogant, callous and certain.

people.imagined: Dawn, knee-deep in the snow-melt pool with blue-white hands held out of the water, not seeming to feel the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn, knee-deep in the snow-melt pool below the forge, he holds a pair of long black tongs in both blue-white hands and looks at the viewer, quite still, as if the cold did not touch him. Face: a long, thin, old face of sixty-five; skin blue-white like a drowned man's; thin grey-white eyebrows; pale blue-grey eyes; a pinched mouth with bluish-grey lips; a sparse white beard with faint frost on it; he exhales visible vapour though the morning is mild. Hair: thin white hair knotted behind. Body: thin, narrow and bent at the shoulders. Clothing: a dark grey-brown wool tunic with a black felt apron, sleeves pushed above the elbow, trousers rolled above the knee and wet; a scarf of grey wool. Hands and objects: bloodless blue-white hands with knuckles swollen by old cold, gripping the black iron River Tongs, worn smooth; a sword blade half-submerged where he has just quenched it, steam coiling; a small cup of tea sitting untouched and cooling on the stone edge. Background: a pale ice-blue pool with a thin ring of rime on its stone lip and a little ice floating, wisps of mist, and a coal-carrier's girl small and far off at the frame's edge watching the tongs. Light: cold blue-white dawn light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, remote, hooded look with the pale eyes steady and the pinched mouth shut, a withdrawn old man who loves what he alone can do.

people.imagined: At the mine head, shaking a pair of dice in her fist and laughing as a tally dispute is settled.
people.subject: The moment: at the mine head, a tally dispute among diggers is settled by dice; she shakes two bone dice in her fist beside her ear, laughing loudly, and winks at the viewer. Face: a broad, laughing, weathered face of forty-eight; a wide mouth showing many teeth; crinkled bright eyes; fine iron-grey dust sparkling in her hair and eyebrows; ruddy cheeks. Hair: thick brown-grey hair twisted into a heavy knot, dusted with iron. Body: broad, strong and sturdy; the dice are worn smooth and one corner is chipped. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic with a black felt apron, tally sticks stuck in her belt in a bundle, sleeves rolled; wool leggings; boots grey with ore. Hands and objects: a fist holding two bone dice up by her ear; a bundle of tally sticks at her belt, each notched; around her neck on a cord hangs a small iron nail she calls luck; the mine head's scaffold shows rope ladders and a bucket on a pulley; her hands are broad with short nails, rimmed with grey ore dust, and she has an extra tally stick behind her ear. Background: a mine-head scaffold, a line of diggers, grey mountain; behind her two diggers crouch over a dispute scratched in dust and wait, grinning, for her throw. Light: bright hard light from the upper left. Expression: gregarious, merry, sharp underneath.

people.imagined: Winter dusk, bare-chested at the forge, laughing at the falling snow while a bright blade glows orange in his tongs.
people.subject: The moment: winter dusk; bare-chested at the forge he laughs at the falling snow while a bright blade glows orange in his tongs, turning to the viewer with a wide laugh, steam rising from his shoulders. Face: a lean, sun-dark, handsome face of thirty-five; a wide laugh; white teeth; black eyes with a fierce spark; a strong nose; stubble; sweat; a faded red cloth band holds the sweat back on his brow; his arms are marked with fine pale spark scars, fewer than the older smiths'; behind him in the shadow a thick-set old smith with a burnt beard watches. Hair: black, loose and tousled to the shoulder, a leather thong at the brow. Body: lean, muscular and sinewy, bare chest and arms; snow collects on his bare shoulders and melts instantly into steam; a clay jug of strong millet wine stands on the anvil with its stopper off. Clothing: a black felt apron tied low over trousers and nothing else above; a leather thumb-ring; boots; at his belt hangs a leather bag of steppe salt, the thing he says he will carry home. Hands and objects: tongs holding a sword blade glowing orange-red, held up high; snowflakes melting on his skin. Background: a forge mouth, snow in the air, grey mountain. Light: orange glow from below on his face, cold blue snow-light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, impatient and generous.

people.imagined: In the yard carrying her own coal ration across to her grandfather's forge, glancing up with half a brow.
people.subject: The moment: crossing the forge yard with a coal basket on her hip, she stops and looks sidelong at the viewer, carrying her own ration to her grandfather's forge. Face: a square, determined face of twenty-three with her grandfather's jaw; one eyebrow missing entirely, the skin smooth where it was burned off, big and plain; brave brown eyes; set mouth; the basket of coal on her hip is covered with a scrap of cloth to keep it from her father's eye; her remaining eyebrow is thick and dark, the missing one a smooth patch of paler skin. Hair: black, braided and pinned up. Body: sturdy, short, squared; behind her across the yard her grandfather's forge door stands open with a dull red glow; her father's tall black-aproned figure is a distant dark shape at the opposite door, his back turned; a dusting of coal dust is on her shoulders. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic, a black felt apron, sleeves short; a basket-strap; boots. Hands and objects: a small basket of black coal on her hip, her free hand holding its rim. Background: a stone yard with a forge chimney; a small burn blister on her left wrist is half-healed. Light: clear light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, brave, honest.

people.imagined: With the coal pole across his neck, answering to his name on the second try with a puzzled look.
people.subject: The moment: with the coal pole across his neck he answers to his name on the second try, scratching his head with one hand and squinting slightly in the sun, puzzled, wondering what he was promised. Face: a broad, easy, puzzled boy's face of seventeen; mild round eyes; the mouth slightly open; a smudge of soot on one cheek. Hair: short black, standing up. Body: strong, thick-necked and stooped under the pole, a thick callus ridge running across the nape like a rope. Clothing: a clean dark grey-brown tunic and felt vest with short sleeves; sturdy trousers; boots tied with cord at the toe; a small child's wooden hammer toy tucked in his belt, a gift from his sister, and a purple bruise on one shin. Hands and objects: the pole smooth and dark with sweat across his shoulders, with a deep groove worn in the wood where it sits and a basket hanging at each end; one hand over the pole, the other scratching his head. Background: a coal road, the baskets swinging and spilling a few black lumps. Light: hazy light from the upper left. Expression: a blank, mild, slightly baffled look, the eyebrows drawn together and the mouth open, a good-natured boy who is willing to do whatever he is told and rarely quite sure what it was.

people.imagined: Low-voiced in the polishing house, holding a blade to catch the moon; she pours tea at the same time.
people.subject: The moment: low-voiced in the polishing house; she holds a polished blade tilted to catch the lamp like a moon, and lowers her eyes calmly to the viewer. Face: a calm, smooth oval face of thirty-one; pumice-smoothed fingertips; soft dark eyes; level brows; a small gentle mouth; the blade she holds is so bright that the room's lamp, a window and her own calm face show in it as small curved pictures; her voice is imagined as low, and her lips are slightly parted as if about to whisper. Hair: black, in a low knot, pinned with a plain pin. Body: slender and composed. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic, a spotless black felt apron, sleeves tied back with cord; her fingertips are smooth and pink from pumice and she holds the blade by its tang with a soft cloth. Hands and objects: a mirror-bright blade across both palms, reflecting a pale round gleam; a small tea bowl at her knee; on the low table beside her sits a pot of tea with two bowls, one for an old man who has not yet come. Background: a quiet shed, racks of blades; a sack of fine pumice and a box of soft cloths stand behind her. Light: soft lamplight from the upper left. Expression: calm, patient, humble.

people.imagined: At the forge door with a cup of wine for a factor; shows an ink-stained thumbnail and new boots.
people.subject: The moment: at the forge door with a cup of wine for a factor; he holds it out to the viewer with an eager smile, ink-stained thumb up. Face: a bright, round, eager face of twenty-one; clean-shaven; quick eyes; a thin moustache fuzz; his boots are good brown calf leather with brass eyelets, still shiny and a size too ambitious for a forge yard; he has a bundle of oilcloth-wrapped complaints tucked under one arm, and his cheeks are pink from the climb up the mountain track. Hair: brown, neat, parted and oiled. Body: medium, upright, a little puffed; he stands on tiptoe slightly to look taller. Clothing: a dark tunic and apron, clean, and good polished leather boots that look new; behind him a factor in a fur-trimmed coat is blurred, half-turned; his shirt collar is starched and a little too high, and a tiny ink blot stains the cuff. Hands and objects: a wine cup in one hand; an ink-blackened thumbnail clearly shown on the other; an inked thumbnail is plain on the hand that holds out a small clay cup of wine, and a smudge of ink runs down the side of his finger. Background: a forge gate, a mountain. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: gregarious, ambitious and loyal.

people.imagined: Weighing a lump of ore in her palm, eyes narrowed, a handful of rice weighed on the other hand.
people.subject: The moment: weighing a lump of ore in her palm, eyes narrowed; she looks suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a thin, wary face of twenty-seven; narrowed dark eyes; thin pressed lips; heavy dark nails; black iron dust in the creases of her cheeks; she weighs it up and down as though counting, lips moving; a streak of black dust runs across her forehead where she has wiped sweat. Hair: black, short and tied up. Body: wiry and tense. Clothing: a dark grey-brown tunic, a black felt apron, sleeves short; on the bench behind her stand baskets of ore, the star mine's lot set apart under a cloth that she has not been allowed to lift; her rice bowl rests on a shelf with a small cloth pouch; she is hunched, with her left hand curled round the grains as if protecting them. Hands and objects: black iron dust under every nail, shown; a rough dark ore lump on one palm and a few grains of rice on the other. Background: a mine shed with ore baskets; the lump of ore is dull dark with a faint orange rust-scale. Light: dim light from the upper left. Expression: diligent, paranoid and just.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder, as painted on the gate wall: lean, white-browed, snow melting on his shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, as painted on the gate wall, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened: a lean man stands in snow with a pair of black tongs, looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, hard face of sixty with white eyebrows; deep lines; stern pale eyes; a long chin; the white eyebrows glow against the aged brown skin. Hair: grey-white, tied back; behind him a narrow river shows as a pale blue ribbon below the peaks, and a second smaller figure, the first quench-keeper, stands knee-deep in it with a pair of tongs. Body: lean, tall, spare. Clothing: a heavy felt apron over a plain grey tunic, snow melting on both shoulders; snow lies thick on the black felt apron and on both shoulders and a thin stream of melt runs from them. Hands and objects: a pair of black tongs raised, a glowing bar between them. Background: snow peaks, a pool; the wall painting has pale plaster cracks across it, and flakes of old red lacquer; the gate wall's plaster is a pale grey-green, with an old sooty smear along its lower edge from centuries of forge smoke. Light: faded, pale; the glowing bar between the tongs is a thin line of faded orange. Expression: stubborn, devout and severe.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the old smith, one shoulder lower than the other after sixty years at the anvil.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened: a stooped old smith stands with his right shoulder dropped, looking quietly at the viewer. Face: a stooped smith's kind weathered face of eighty; white beard; gentle eyes; deep creases; his white beard is thin, and his eyes are soft and a little wet. Hair: white, thin. Body: one shoulder visibly lower than the other, stooped; his dropped right shoulder pulls the whole body into a gentle slant; a thin crack runs through the old silk down the middle of the portrait, repaired with a strip of paper on the back, and dark foxing spots dapple the edges. Clothing: a black felt apron over a grey tunic; the old smith's apron has a dark scorched hem and is smoothed pale at the front where he leaned on the anvil for sixty years. Hands and objects: a small hammer in his right hand held at his side. Background: a dim forge, a hint of a long halberd. Light: faded warm light; faint behind him on the wall, the outline of a long halberd with a curved blade is hung in lighter paint. Expression: loyal, humble and calm.
